title: Traffic Signal
statement:
Write a function that takes a signal color string: "red", "yellow", or "green".
Return "stop", "wait", or "go" matching the color.
If the color is anything else, return "unknown".
hints: Compare the color with exact lowercase words.
Have a final else for unknown colors.

solution.approach: Branch on the color string and return the matching action, with a default of unknown.
solution.complexity: Fixed tiny work — a few comparisons.
